title: One Year In: Grading Jacksonville’s 2025 Rookie Class

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: One Year In: Grading Jacksonville’s 2025 Rookie Class
sources.description: Year one is in the books, and Jacksonville's 2025 draft class will be remembered as much for what could have been as what actually was. We put every pick from James Gladstone's inaugural Jaguars draft class under the microscope.
